practiceReport.name: Christian Benford
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (86% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: First Limited session (Wed DNP -> Thu LP) following prior-game absence without prior practice — awaiting Friday load response
practiceReport.beatComment: Benford is working through a groin injury that caused him to be sidelined for Sunday's win against the Dolphins. His return to practice is encouraging, even if it was in a limited capacity, and a full session Wednesday would put the fifth-year pro on track to return for Thanksgiving Day against the Chiefs. If Benford cannot play Thursday, then the Bills would likely elevate Tre'Davious White from the practice squad and rotate him with Maxwell Hairston at outside cornerback opposite Davison Igbinosun.

practiceReport.name: Dorian Williams
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Consecutive Wed/Thu Limited (LP -> LP) following prior-game absence
practiceReport.beatComment: Williams did not play in Sunday's win over the Dolphins due to a calf injury that kept him out of all Week 11 prep. The inside linebacker's estimated presence Monday is promising, but he will likely need to suit up for on-field work Tuesday and Wednesday to get the green light ahead of Thursday night's Thanksgiving showdown with the Chiefs.

practiceReport.name: Dalton Kincaid
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Consecutive Wed/Thu Limited (LP -> LP) following prior-game absence
practiceReport.beatComment: Kincaid, who was inactive for this past Sunday's win over the Dolphins, logged a 'limited' listing on the Bills' Monday through Wednesday practice/injury reports before being deemed 'questionable' to face Kansas City. Per Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard, following Tuesday's practice Kincaid said that he's "most likely playing" Thursday, with the tight end's Week 12 status, either way, set to be confirmed once Buffalo's scratches are posted ahead of the team's 8:20 pm kickoff.

practiceReport.name: Amani Hooker
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 97% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Hooker has now played in two games for the Bills, logging 100 percent of the team's defensive reps in Week 11 and 98 percent in Week 12. The strong safety has made for a good pairing with Cole Bishop, and the duo has helped the Bills' defense extend its streak of not allowing a touchdown to 15 straight quarters of play.

practiceReport.name: Ed Oliver
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Oliver popped up on the injury report after informing the team's medical staff of oblique pain and was listed as questionable. However, the veteran is cleared to play for Sunday's divisional meeting with Miami, potentially resulting in fewer snaps for DeWayne Carter, Greg Gaines and Landon Jackson.

practiceReport.name: Greg Rousseau
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (72% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Rousseau was limited in Monday's session while managing a back injury, but his full participation Tuesday indicates that the sixth-year edge rusher will be available against the Chiefs on Thanksgiving Day. Rousseau logged two sacks against the Dolphins on Sunday, and his 10.0 sacks through 10 regular-season games are second-most in the NFL behind Will Anderson (11.5).

practiceReport.name: Ty Johnson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Johnson did not carry the rock much at all in the contest. The running back did, however, rank third in receiving yards for Buffalo behind Khalil Shakir (101) and DJ Moore (91). Johnson should continue to see receiving opportunities in Week 12 against the Chiefs as the Bills' preferred third-down back.

practiceReport.name: Jackson Hawes
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Hawes was in danger of missing this contest due to a shoulder issue, though he will avoid his first absence of the 2026 campaign Sunday versus Miami. With Dalton Kincaid (thumb) sidelined in Week 11, Hawes will have an opportunity to get more involved than usual behind Dawson Knox.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Joshua Palmer
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: In Palmer's absence, DJ Moore, Khalil Shakir and Keon Coleman will lead the Bills WR corps Monday night against the Vikings, with Greg Dortch and Trent Sherfield available in reserve. The earliest that Palmer can return to the mix is Sunday, Dec. 6 against the Patriots.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Ar'maj Reed-Adams
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: It's not immediately clear when he suffered the back injury, but Reed-Adams will now have to sit out at least four games as he recovers. His absence leaves veteran Austin Corbett as Buffalo's undisputed backup plan at guard behind starters Alec Anderson and O'Cyrus Torrence.
